# nemau compute instance

Manage compute instances.

## Usage

```
nemau compute instance [command]
```

Aliases: `instances`, `i`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [create](nemau_compute_instance_create.md) | Create an instance |
| [delete](nemau_compute_instance_delete.md) | Delete an instance |
| [get](nemau_compute_instance_get.md) | Show one instance |
| [list](nemau_compute_instance_list.md) | List the project's instances |
| [metrics](nemau_compute_instance_metrics.md) | An instance's metrics |
| [pause](nemau_compute_instance_pause.md) | Pause an instance in memory |
| [reboot](nemau_compute_instance_reboot.md) | Reboot an instance |
| [resize](nemau_compute_instance_resize.md) | Resize an instance |
| [resume](nemau_compute_instance_resume.md) | Resume a suspended instance |
| [set-security-groups](nemau_compute_instance_set-security-groups.md) | Replace an instance's security groups |
| [start](nemau_compute_instance_start.md) | Start an instance |
| [stop](nemau_compute_instance_stop.md) | Stop an instance |
| [suspend](nemau_compute_instance_suspend.md) | Suspend an instance to disk |
| [unpause](nemau_compute_instance_unpause.md) | Resume a paused instance |
| [update](nemau_compute_instance_update.md) | Change an instance's name or description |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
